figures.caption: Fig. 4. Cross-contrast translation cases, T1n→T1c (top) and T2w→T2f (bottom): slice, tumor-centered crop (yellow box) and absolute error, with the ground-truth tumor contour in cyan. Annotations give full-volume PSNR and tumor MAE.

Fig. 2. Latent Structure Flow. In every block, a basis estimated jointly from the state and the condition splits the input tokens into structure Sw and residual Rw (Eq. (3)). Sw is routed to the global branch and Rw to the local branch; the output adds the predicted structural change and output residual to Sw (Eq. (5)).

Fig. 1. Decoded effect of latent errors of equal norm on one subject: slice with PSNR, lesion crop, and absolute error with MAE. Attenuating the structure causes the largest distortion; residual errors change only local appearance.
